what: structure probes. markers: a click (0.02) added to a steady vowel /a/ at one position per render, the render without it subtracted, so each copy of the click in the output shows where (delay) and how strongly (amplitude: the kernel sum) that input instant is read. grain_time_scale: output samples per input sample along a copy track (1: copied as is; below 1: read faster, formants up). tone: an inharmonic sine on a vowel, energy near the tone and near tone x ratio
